parameters.name: ChannelName
parameters.description: A unique name for the replication channel. This name identifies the replication link.

parameters.name: DbInstanceId
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can call the `DescribeDBInstances` operation to obtain this ID.

parameters.name: MasterHost
parameters.description: The endpoint of the primary database, which can be an IP address or a domain name.

parameters.name: MasterPassword
parameters.description: The Base64-encoded password for the replication user account.

parameters.name: MasterPort
parameters.description: The port of the primary database. For example, the default port for MySQL is 3306.

parameters.name: MasterUser
parameters.description: The username for the replication account on the primary database.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query the most recent region list.
